messages:
Alex CSM: Drafting a one-page customer-facing 'ramp stitch' checklist: prefill, client batching guidance, streaming fallback, and post-launch feedback. Quick eyes?
Jamie Eng: Love it. Keep it short. Suggest metrics: prefill_cost/hr, prefills_active, p50/p90 latency, stream_error_rate.
Alex CSM: Draft TTLs: default 30m, high-risk 5m, cooldown 2h. High-risk triggers = >=3 renewal misses OR >25% weekly usage drop.
Lin SRE: Ops notes: warm-pool uses tenant affinity + sticky routing. Add circuit-breaker to fall back to on-demand if cost delta > 50% in 30m. Tag nodes with `cs:ramp`.
Maya CS: I'll make a 72h post-launch survey (3 quick Qs + optional comment) and a short kickoff blurb for customers.
Devon Eng: Implementation: gate under `cs.ramp_stitch_v1`. Emit metrics and add alert: prefill_cost > budget_cap*1.2 in 1h OR stream_error_rate >5% for 15m.
Jamie Eng: Add a sample curl & SDK snippet for partners to trigger prefill during staging.
Onboard-bot: Reminder set: attach CS note + survey link to account record after launch.
Alex CSM: Action items: Maya survey + email copy, Lin add route flag/CB, Jamie dashboard panels, Devon feature flag. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. Thanks :rocket:
root_message: Alex CSM: Drafting a one-page customer-facing 'ramp stitch' checklist: prefill, client batching guidance, streaming fallback, and post-launch feedback. Quick eyes?
